prompt: jsonpatch/ implements part of RFC 6902 (JSON Patch: add, remove, replace) over RFC 6901 pointers. Fix apply_patch so that: pointer escapes decode correctly (~1 is '/', ~0 is '~', so the token '~01' is the key '~1'); 'remove' on a list removes the element at that index; 'add' to a list accepts '-' to append and an index equal to the list length (inserting otherwise); 'replace' needs the target to exist; the path '' (root) replaces the whole document for 'add'/'replace'. The input document must never be modified (return a new one). Any invalid operation (unknown op, missing key or index, index out of range, non-numeric list index, or removing the root) raises PatchError.
